questions.question_text: What is one of the main benefits of daily journaling for teens, as discussed in Chapter 6?

options.text: It helps improve handwriting skills for school assignments
It provides a stress release and a way to process emotions without judgment
It guarantees better grades in creative writing classes
It replaces the need for talking to friends or family about problemsCorrect Answer:B) It provides a stress release and a way to process emotions without judgment

questions.question_text: Which of the following best describes a Gratitude Journal, according to Chapter 6?

options.text: A journal where you write down your dreams immediately after waking up
A journal focused on writing about things you’re thankful for, big or small
A journal for reflecting deeply on why certain events or feelings happened
A journal used to plan future goals and career aspirationsCorrect Answer:B) A journal focused on writing about things you’re thankful for, big or small

questions.question_text: How can writing prompts help teens with journaling, as explained in Chapter 6?

options.text: They provide strict rules to ensure journal entries are written correctly
They act as starting points to overcome a blank page and spark personal reflection
They are only useful for turning journal entries into creative stories
They limit the topics teens can write about to avoid emotional topicsCorrect Answer:B) They act as starting points to overcome a blank page and spark personal reflection

questions.question_text: What is a key step in turning a journal entry into a creative piece, as outlined in Chapter 6?

options.text: Deleting the original entry to start fresh with a new idea
Identifying the core feeling or idea in the entry to build a poem, story, or song around it
Copying the entry word-for-word into a new format without changes
Sharing the entry online before deciding on a creative formCorrect Answer:B) Identifying the core feeling or idea in the entry to build a poem, story, or song around it
